android.desc:
Tired of notification overload? Cortex is the intelligent manager you’ve been waiting for. It uses on-device and cloud AI to read, understand, and consolidate everything into one persistent “Glance” — so you stay informed without being interrupted.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧠 DUAL - ENGINE AI

► Local AI (100% Private, Offline)
Runs entirely on-device after a one-time ~210 MB model download. Handles summarization and importance tagging (Critical/High/Medium/Low). Nothing ever leaves your phone.

► Cloud AI (Premium)
Optional upgrade for deeper context (“is this a bill?”), semantic filtering, and natural-language auto-replies.

You choose per-rule which engine powers what. Your data, your control.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👀 THE GLANCE

No more avalanche. One clean, expandable summary replaces dozens of pings:

● Sam: Dinner @ 9pm
● Oracle: Invoice #2241 due tomorrow · $487.50
● Ring: Package delivered at front door

Tap to expand, swipe to clear, or let it stay until you’re ready.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚡ MAGIC RULE BUILDER

Just chat in plain English:

"Silence work apps on weekends unless my boss says URGENT"

"Let family through at work only if it’s actually important"

Cortex instantly builds the logic and suggests smarter alternatives. Prefer precision? Use the block-based editor for granular control.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛠️ POWER AUTOMATION

CONDITIONS
● App
● Time & schedule
● Keywords & Regex
● Screen/ringer state
● AI importance
● Semantic meaning
● OTP/2FA detection

ACTIONS
● Add to Glance
● Batch release (every 30 min or at 5 PM)
● AI or custom auto-reply
● Dismiss
● Copy OTP
● TTS readout
● Custom sound/vibration
● Webhook

Built-in vibration patterns: Heartbeat, SOS, Double-tap, etc.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 ANALYTICS & HISTORY

● Searchable log of every notification (blocked ones optional)
● Hourly/daily volume charts
● Top distracting apps
● Importance breakdown
● Rule performance

See exactly how much focus you’ve reclaimed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔗 WEBHOOKS & INTEGRATIONS

Send any notification as JSON to Home Assistant, IFTTT, Zapier, Node-RED, or your server.

● Flash lights on security alerts
● Log deliveries
● Push 2FA to desktop
● etc.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛡️ PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST

● Local AI = zero data leaves device
● Cloud AI = encrypted in transit, deleted immediately after
